info.title: WiNGS REST API
info.description: WiNGS is a web based platform used for federated genome analysis in a privacy controlled manner.WINGS REST API is accessible only for registered WiNGS Users.

post.summary: WiNGS Users can generate API key only from WiNGS UI. WiNGS UI -> Click user icon -> Generate API Key --> Create API Key
post.description: WiNGS User does not have direct access to this API.Details are provided only for informational purpose. Fetch the WiNGS API token to access API. Only 1 token can be generated by a WiNGS User. Tokens are credentials, please store them properly. We don't store tokens and you cannot fetch the token again using WiNGS interface.

403.description: Reached Token Limit.Cannot generate new tokens

post.summary: WiNGS User can revoke API key only from WiNGS UI. WiNGS UI -> Click user icon -> Generate API Key --> Revoke API Key
post.description: WiNGS User does not have direct access to this API.Details are provided only for informational purpose. User can revoke the token which is used as the Bearer Token

post.summary: WiNGS Revoke Token-Admin privilege
post.description: WiNGS User does not have direct access to this API.Details are provided only for informational purpose. WiNGS Admin will be provided access if required.Admin can revoke the token of the user within his center

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: admin is the only supported value. Token bearer should be admin of the center

post.summary: Forgot WiNGS Token - Regenerate
post.description: WiNGS User does not have direct access to this API.Details are provided only for informational purpose. Allows only 2 attempts.Forgot token endpoint can be used to generate a new token when the old token is lost

403.description: Reached Forgot Token Limit. Cannot generate new tokens

post.summary: WiNGS Revoke Token-Admin privilege
post.description: WiNGS User does not have direct access to this API.Details are provided only for informational purpose. WiNGS Admin will be provided access if needed.Admin can reactivate API access for the user mentioned in the request body

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: admin is the only supported value. Token bearer should be admin of the center

post.description: Precomputation request

post.summary: Get the results of variant discovery request
post.description: Variant Discovery results

200.description:
- status will be inprogress or expired or completed
- annotations will have the annotations of every variant if status is completed
- annotations will be {} if status is not completed
- variant-counts contains the variant and hpo terms presence/absence combination counts
- variant-counts will be {} if status is not completed   
- overall will be {"var+phen": 0,"var-phen": 0, "-var+phen": 0,"-var-phen": 0} is  'inprogress'
- overall will have the cumulated counts for the variants and hpo terms
